'''Kourend Castle Teleport''' teleports the player to the [[Kourend Castle]] courtyard, by the [[Statue (King Rada I)|statue of King Rada I]]. Completion of [[Client of Kourend]] is required to cast the spell.

==Changes==
{{Subject changes header}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 10 January 2024
|update = Children of the Sun
|poll = Varlamore Activities & Kourend Changes
|change = 
* The spell is now unlocked by completing [[Client of Kourend]], rather than through reading [[transportation Incantations]].
* The Magic level required has been reduced from 69 to 48.
* The experience gained has been reduced from 81.5 to 58.
* The runes required have been changed; previously, it required 5 fire, 4 water, 2 soul, and 2 law runes.
* The ability to craft [[magic tablet]]s for this spell has been added.
* Players will no longer chant the incantation {{overhead|Thadior Agrula Elevo|color=yellow}} when using the teleport.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 10 January 2019
|update = The Kebos Lowlands
|change = Spell name changed from "Teleport to Kourend" to "Kourend Castle Teleport".
}}
